name: odd_cycle_is_factor_critical
lines: ⊢ (if ↑(u - v) % 2 = 1 then u + 1 else u - 1) ≠ v
⊢ let f := fun x => if ↑(x - v) % 2 = 1 then x + 1 else x - 1;
f : Fin (2 * n + 1) → Fin (2 * n + 1) := fun x => if ↑(x - v) % 2 = 1 then x + 1 else x - 1
⊢ (if ↑(u - v) % 2 = 1 then u + 1 else u - 1) = u + 1
⊢ (if ↑(u + 1 - v) % 2 = 1 then u + 1 + 1 else u + 1 - 1) = u
⊢ (if ↑(u - v) % 2 = 1 then u + 1 else u - 1) = u - 1
⊢ (if ↑(u - 1 - v) % 2 = 1 then u - 1 + 1 else u - 1 - 1) = u
⊢ ↑(u - if ↑(u - v) % 2 = 1 then u + 1 else u - 1) = 1 ∨ ↑((if ↑(u - v) % 2 = 1 then u + 1 else u - 1) - u) = 1
M : H.Subgraph := { verts := Set.univ, Adj := fun x y => y = σ x, adj_sub := ⋯, edge_vert := ⋯, symm := ⋯ }
⊢ ∀ {v w : ↑s}, w = σ v → H.Adj v w
⊢ ∀ (a b : ↑s), b = σ a → a = σ b
⊢ ∀ (y : ↑{v}ᶜ), (fun w => M.Adj x w) y → y = σ x
